title: Muxed-account strkey with muxed id 2^53+1, the first id a float64 cannot hold
why: 9007199254740993 rounds to 9007199254740992 in a float64, so a reader that converts the id to a JavaScript number or a JSON double returns a different account route without an error.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.muxed-id-2-pow-53-plus-1.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Executed in every probe column as vector 9S11 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json).
